name: Alikhan Bukeikhanov
contribution: A Kazakh politician, statesman, journalist and publisher who led the Alash party and the provisional government of Alash Orda from 1917 to 1920.
legacy: This person was a Kazakh politician, statesman, journalist and publisher who led the Alash party and the provisional government of Alash Orda from 1917 to 1920.

checks.lead: Alikhan Nurmukhameduly Bukeikhanov (5 March 1866 – 27 September 1937) was a Kazakh politician, statesman, journalist and publisher who led the Alash party and the provisional government of Alash Orda from 1917 to 1920.
